worked_solution: We can see that $\overset{―}{AB}$ is a line segment whose endpoints lie on the circle. So, $\overset{―}{AB}$ is a chord. It is not a diameter since the line segment does not pass through the center of the circle.

Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

We can see that AB― is a line segment whose endpoints lie on the circle. So, AB― is a chord. It is not a diameter since the line segment does not pass through the center of the circle.
